[[Zalo Soulhaunch]] is a [[Losaru]] [[Centaur]] [[boss]] that appears in [[the Scar]].

== Locations ==
* [[Crystal Desert]]
** {{NPC location|The Scar}}

* {{skill icon|Animate Bone Fiend}}
* {{skill icon|Life Siphon}}
* {{skill icon|Shadow Strike}}
* {{skill icon|Signet of Agony}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Losaru Mane]]
* [[Losaru Necromancer Tunic]]

== Notes ==
* Zalo Soulhaunch is one of six Losaru centaur bosses that spawns randomly at six spawn points.  The spawn points are shared with [[Aguo Gruffmane]], [[Caza Windedcalf]], [[Mina Brillianthaunch]], [[Gret Waveringmane]], and [[Doro Icehide]].
* If the [[quest]] [[The Warrior's Path]] is active, [[Orshad Chieftain]] will be at one of the easternmost spawn point, thus replacing one of the normal bosses.
